 Recruiting process at Crystalloids 
 Hiring Journey 1 
 1. Application & Initial Review 
Submit your CV and cover letter through our careers page. Our HRM team reviews your profile, and you'll always get a response: yes or no, so you can move forward with clarity.

If there's a potential match, we'll invite you for a 45-minute conversation with HR at our Rotterdam office. It's about getting to know each other, aligning expectations, and giving you a feel for our culture. 
We will arrange the interview online if you're not based in the Netherlands. 
In-person 3. Technical / Role-Specific Assignment 
Spend a day working on a practical assignment, guided by one of our team members. You'll get a real taste of the role and how we collaborate. 
 4. Team Technical Fit Interview 
Meet our Heads of Development in an online interview. Together, we'll explore your skills and working style to find the best fit within our teams. 
 5. Meeting with Our Managing Partner 
Have an informal talk with our Managing Partner/CEO to connect on vision, values, and leadership. 
 6. Offer & Onboarding 
We'll share a personalised offer and walk you through salary, benefits, and your growth path. From day one, you'll know exactly where you stand and how we'll support your development.
